status: Forward-model design before fitting new observed photometry; exact creation timestamp is also recorded by acquisition/run records.
question: Which stellar ages and progenitor-delay summaries are compatible with observed host fluxes without imposing a narrow parametric star-formation history?
primary_data: Roman2018 released local SDSS ugriz fluxes, preserving signed/negative measurements; extend only to other surveys with verified passbands and zero points.
sfh: Nonnegative mixture of simple stellar populations; no shrinkage or parametric-age prior. Age support cannot exceed cosmic time at the object's redshift. This discrete basis is an explicit model approximation.
foreground: Forward F99 Rv3.1 using SFD coordinates and declared0.86 scale; compare foreground-scale sensitivity rather than double-correcting published dereddened fluxes.
measurement_likelihood: Released per-band Gaussian flux errors, only when their calibration/foreground semantics are verified; missing inter-band/calibration covariance remains a limitation. No conversion of negative fluxes to magnitudes.
age_bound: Charnes-Cooper transform of mass-weighted age yields a second-order-cone optimization over nonnegative mixtures in the Gaussian flux ellipsoid. Absolute chi-square quantile with degrees equal to measured band count defines a simultaneous95% mean-flux confidence region conditional on exact Gaussian noise and included physical model. Not a Wilks profile or Bayesian age posterior.
native_compute: FSPS Fortran and compiled conic solver; parallel independent objects. Profile actual cost and implement C++/OpenMP or CUDA only where measured beneficial, with independent double-precision comparisons.
validation: Photon-weighted AB integration versus native FSPS filters
Convex bound versus independent primal constrained optimization
cosmology_gate: No physical survey distance correction until observational age validation, joint population/selection and recovery gates pass. No preference for an acceleration outcome.

pre_fit_amendment.primary_extension: SDSS 3arcsec fibre fluxes matched to independently recovered 3arcsec spectra; spectral Dn4000 held out first, then optional Fieller ratio constraint. Roman local photometry retained as a distinct aperture experiment.
pre_fit_amendment.sensitivity: Statistical-only flux errors primary; independent 0.03mag per-band model/calibration discrepancy added in quadrature as explicitly assumed sensitivity, not a measured covariance. Foreground scales 0.86 and 1.0 SFD compared on deterministic validation subset.
pre_fit_amendment.joint_region: Use 97.5% absolute photometry ellipsoid and 97.5% Fieller index interval. Bonferroni gives at least95% joint conditional coverage without assuming cross-data independence; diagonal within-spectrum and photometric noise remain assumptions.
pre_fit_amendment.sample: Run all recovered SDSS fibre counterparts with all5finite positive errors, positive summed flux, reliable spectral redshift. No selection by age, HR, Dn value, or fit residual. Roman local SDSS family likewise all5finiteerrors.

sdss_zero_point.uncertainty: Offsets approximate at0.01-0.02mag; include no-offset deterministic subset sensitivity. Multiply signed flux and error by10**(-.4*delta_mag). Roman AB interface not corrected a second time.

pre_des_fit_amendment.sample: All331 unique selected Dovekie DES hosts with deep_quality & DLR<4 and finite positive errors in all8bands; no age or residual selection.
pre_des_fit_amendment.photometry: Released calibrated+dereddened eightband AB fluxes; no second MW correction. DECamugriz and VISTA J,H,Ks generic SVO photon response curves; coaddpassband mismatch remains an explicit limitation.
pre_des_fit_amendment.comparison: Same formed-mass SSP-mixture age feasibility, native5/8bandchi-square dimension; statistical-only vs0.03mag perband discrepancy. Highzavailable subset is not assumed representative; selectiontransport failedcalibration is recorded separately.

review_correction.supersedes: Positive summed flux gate in the initial sample amendment. This was a selection error, not an invalid-input test.
review_correction.change: Retain every finite signed band measurement with positive error; explicitly admit any age when zero flux lies inside the mean-flux ellipsoid. Three recovered Roman nondetections are analytically uninformative; allnegative inconsistent objects remain as model failures. This correction was made after initial fit inspection and independent review, not retrospectively blinded.
review_correction.Roman_calibration: Keep catalogue-declared ABsystem as main branch; it is not proof that native SDSSu/z offsets were alreadyapplied. Add approximateSDSS-to-ABoffset sensitivity on same deterministic8RomanIDs.

numerical_review_correction.finding: Matching nativeFSPS observer-wavelength discretization is not sufficient for accurate DESpassband integration; discarded preview differs from convergedintegration byup to0.025mag onthevalidationgrid.
numerical_review_correction.adopted: FourpointGauss-Legendre integration on unionof instrumentfilterknots andredshiftedSSPknots; independentdense.1/.5Angstromchecks, then allaffectedfitsrerun. This is a numericalrepair, not a selectedphysicalmodel.
